newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed, crosses boost volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed, crosses boost volume.

text.p: LIFFE sugar traded in a tight range, with nearbys moving higher, while months further out went down.
Activity was boosted by trade in crosses, traders said. "There's been some good activity," one said. "But there are a lot of crosses.

By 1015 GMT a total of 1,263 lots had changed hands. But the trader pointed out that some 250 December to March crosses alone accounted for 500 lots, and they were not the only cross trades which had been done.
Front month August was 80 cents higher at $322.00 on 314 lots, while March, which was most active was 50 cents down at $308.10 on volume of 344 lots.
"No-one seems to be anticipating much excitement in the futures market without fundamental news and we agree with this view," brokers GNI said.
